text:
incident-bot: [P0] SablePoint (vpc-sable-03 / dp-42) reporting high error rate from funcall pipeline: 5xx spike and paging loops. Pager: @alice_oncall. https://internal.incidents/2148765432

alice_oncall: I'm on it. Customer says tool calls are returning 500s and sometimes responses hang with huge paged payloads. Seen primarily on dedicated pool dp-42.

alice_oncall: Quick log peek shows parser failures: "Unexpected token null in object" for field "metadata.page_token" leading to retry/paging loop.

eva_engineer: sample log snippet:
```
2026-07-08T22:05:12Z ERROR toolcall-parser: json.Unmarshal: invalid character 'n' looking for beginning of value (token "null") at /srv/parse/handler.go:142
2026-07-08T22:05:12Z WARN  toolcall-parser: retrying cursor loop (attempt 3) for request id=sp-8723
```

ben_platform: Sounds like schema drift — SablePoint backend started sending null for page_token instead of empty string. Our parser expects a string and then calls paginate() which trips into an infinite cursor.

carmen_se: Customer confirmed they deployed a small change at ~21:58 that introduced nulls. They're rolling that change back but it's slow due to a canary rollout.

alice_oncall: Customer impact: ~40% of SablePoint's funcall requests to dp-42 failing; affects their user-facing features. Any immediate mitigation we can take?

derek_sre: Mitigation plan (short):
- immediate: apply a proxy shim in funcall-proxy to coerce null -> "" for page_token (hotpatchable)
- immediate fallback: disable function-calling for the customer via feature flag (API) to stop parser path
- medium: deploy tolerant parser change + unit tests, then canary rollout to dp-42

alice_oncall: @ben_platform can you toggle the flag now?

ben_platform: Doing it now. Command:
```
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/flags -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"customer":"sablepoint","enable_tool_calling":false}'
```
Result: 200 OK — flag applied.

incident-bot: Action taken: feature-flag disabled for sablepoint at 2026-07-08T22:12:03Z (actor: ben_platform)

sablepoint_support: Confirmed — we've seen error rate drop immediately after flag toggle. Thank you. Still finishing rollback on our side.

eva_engineer: I'll prepare a 1-line shim we can hotpatch into funcall-proxy (dp-42) and then revert postfix. Patch idea:
```
// coerce null page token into empty string
if payload.metadata != nil {
  if payload.metadata.page_token == nil {
    payload.metadata.page_token = ""
  }
}
```
Deploying to dp-42 within ~10m.

alice_oncall: If shim works we can restore tool calling (behind validation) and then push the parser fix.

derek_sre: Handoff: I'm taking over monitoring at 22:25 UTC for the next hour. @alice_oncall handing off :wave:

alice_oncall: Thanks — follow-ups: create postmortem if rollback not complete in 24h. Also add alert rule for unusual paging error rate to avoid silent regressions.

ben_platform: Shim deployed at 22:20, health metrics: errors dropped to ~2% and latency normalized. Opening PR to add tolerant parsing and tests.

carmen_se: Customer update: rollback completed at 23:05, they'll re-enable feature flag and ask us to watch.

sablepoint_support: Rolled back at 23:05 and re-requesting enable of function-calling.

ben_platform: Re-enabled flag for sablepoint at 23:07 (curl command returned 200). Monitoring stream...

eva_engineer: After re-enable we observed a small blip (~1-2% 502s) then stable. Root cause confirmed: schema drift where page_token became null. Fix PR #4321 submitted with tolerant unmarshal and tests.

alice_oncall: Incident summary: customer-side schema change introduced null page_token causing parser to error and paging loops. Short-term mitigations: feature-flag disable + proxy shim. Long-term: parser fix + tests + alerting.

incident-bot: Incident closed at 2026-07-08T23:20:01Z. Duration: ~1h15m. Severity: P1. Ticket: INC-2026-789.

-- ACTION ITEMS --
- ben_platform: link PR #4321 and schedule canary rollout to dp-42 (due today)
- eva_engineer: follow-up to revert shim after parser fix is live
- product/alerts: add paging-error-rate alert for dedicated pools
- carmen_se: coordinate postmortem with SablePoint and confirm rollback timeline in ticket

Notes: Customer isolation worked as intended (feature-flag + dedicated pool) — we avoided cross-tenant impact. Will document null-handling expectation in VPC onboarding docs. :white_check_mark:
